visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a night scene of vibrant fireworks exploding in the dark sky, casting light over a stadium crowd. Text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) Transition to a daytime outdoor setting where a large crowd of people, mostly in casual summer attire, walk along a paved path toward a stadium. A man with black hair, a beige cap, and a white t-shirt holds up baseball tickets to the camera in front of an Orix Buffaloes sign. (3) The camera captures the entrance of Hotto Motto Field Kobe with banners and flags fluttering. (4) Inside the facility, the man points at posters and photos of baseball legends like Ichiro Suzuki on a white wall. (5) A wide-angle view from the upper stands reveals a lush green baseball field, brown dirt paths, and thousands of spectators under a cloudy evening sky. (6) A close-up shows a digital ticket on a smartphone screen with text and pricing. (7) In the stands, the man holds several paper fans with player portraits. People are seen waving them to cool down. (8) The man is filmed in close-up sitting in a narrow seat, drinking a glass of beer with foam and eating fried fries and a corn dog with ketchup. (9) The night falls, and a spectacular fireworks show begins directly above the stadium, filling the sky with red and gold bursts. (10) Players in blue and white 'BlueWave' uniforms line up on the field and bow toward the audience. (11) Shots of a merchandise store show blue caps and jerseys on shelves. (12) The final sequence shows an energetic crowd in the stands, some with umbrellas, and the man looking out at the stadium from a high vantage point.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 棒球迷一生一定要來體驗一次的. [Logo]: @Stanley_Sportslife. (2) [Subtitle]: 神戶棒球場煙火秀. (3) [Subtitle]: 一般到日本關西看球. (4) [Subtitle]: 下意識會想到的是京瓷巨蛋、甲子園球場. (5) [Subtitle]: 但其實還有個神戶棒球場. (6) [Subtitle]: 是歐力士曾經的主場. (7) [Subtitle]: 也是最近入選名人堂的球星、鈴木一朗. (8) [Subtitle]: 過去在日職的主舞台. (9) [Subtitle]: 我一踏進球場，就被超漂亮的草皮震撼到. (10) [Subtitle]: 位子這次買一疊側、二階C指定席. (11) [Subtitle]: 台幣600塊左右. (12) [Subtitle]: 視野很不錯. (13) [Subtitle]: 但畢竟是夏天，所以還是熱到不行. (14) [Variety]: (當天入場送摺扇有夠實用). (15) [Subtitle]: 加上這座球場歷史悠久，座位老實說很窄. (16) [Variety]: (神戶球場的食物都沒特別驚艷). (17) [Subtitle]: 沒有杯架，螢幕也不大. (18) [Subtitle]: 不過此行最大重點就是看煙火. (19) [Variety]: (買票要小心不要買到看不到煙火的座位). (20) [Subtitle]: 即便這場歐力士從頭落後到尾，煙火一樣還是有. (21) [Subtitle]: 跟台灣不一樣的是，會挑在五局中場休息的時候施放. (22) [Subtitle]: 啦啦隊跟現場的球迷還會一起倒數. (23) [Subtitle]: 我的位置剛好就是最佳觀景台. (24) [Variety]: (其實是有特地選的人生才沒那麼多剛好). (25) [Subtitle]: 中間一度感動到有點雞皮疙瘩. (26) [Subtitle]: 由於今年是阪神大地震30周年. (27) [Subtitle]: 當時神戶傳出嚴重災情. (28) [Subtitle]: 以神戶球場為主場的歐力士藍浪. (29) [Subtitle]: 隔年贏得日本一. (30) [Subtitle]: 對當地居民帶來很大的激勵作用. (31) [Subtitle]: 所以今年在神戶舉行的六場賽事. (32) [Subtitle]: 歐力士都會穿著袖子上寫，神戶加油的前身藍浪隊球衣. (33) [Subtitle]: 有機會的話，下次來日本關西旅遊. (34) [Subtitle]: 可以朝聖一下神戶棒球場. (35) [Subtitle]: 感受一下綠地球場的魅力吧.
